title: Mapping objects and pointwise tensors in enriched cotensors
statement:
Use the universe and complete enriched-category conventions of [def-coef-complete-algebroid], the internal enriched functors, free enrichment and cotensors of [lem-coef-enriched-category-tensor-calculus], and the twisted-arrow construction with source and target $(s,t):\operatorname{Tw}(K)\to K^{\mathrm{op}}\times K$ of [lem-coef-twisted-arrow-left-fibration]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a presentably closed symmetric monoidal infinity category, let $\mathcal E$ be a small complete $\mathcal V$-category, and let $K$ be a small infinity category. Put $\mathcal E^K=\operatorname{Fun}_{\mathcal V}(K_{\mathcal V},\mathcal E)$. For coherent diagrams $F,G:K\to U\mathcal E$ there is a natural equivalence in $\mathcal V$
$$\mathcal E^K(F,G)\simeq\lim_{(k\to k')\in\operatorname{Tw}(K)}\mathcal E(F(k),G(k')).$$
The diagram on the right uses enriched precomposition by $F$ and postcomposition by $G$. Its projections at identity arrows agree with component evaluation, and the comparison retains enriched composition and all naturality parameter simplices.

Suppose in addition that $\mathcal E$ is coherently tensored over $\mathcal V$: for every $A\in\mathcal V$ and $x\in\mathcal E$ there is $A\odot x$ with natural equivalences $\mathcal E(A\odot x,y)\simeq[A,\mathcal E(x,y)]_{\mathcal V}$, compatible with the tensor unit, associativity and evaluation. Then $\mathcal E^K$ is tensored, with $(A\odot F)(k)=A\odot F(k)$ and its induced coherent arrow action. The natural equivalences
$$\mathcal E^K(A\odot F,G)\simeq[A,\mathcal E^K(F,G)]_{\mathcal V}$$
identify the tensor evaluation with its objectwise evaluations, including all parameter simplices. No dualizability assumption on $A$ is imposed. Empty $K$ is allowed. The assertions hold for simplicial indexing shapes after their freely generated infinity categories are used.

source.place: Remark 9.5 for the complete internal enriched functor category, supplemented by the agent-formulated enriched cotensor end and pointwise tensor calculation. Compare the ordinary weighted-end description in Riehl--Verity, Homotopy coherent adjunctions, section 5.1, and the space-valued analogue lem-coef-coherent-end-twisted-arrow-formula. Neither source is claimed to state this full V-valued package verbatim; archival copies WANTED. No Stacks tag states it.
